_comment: I-MAK pricing engine configuration. All rates are ADJUSTABLE — edit and re-run. Defaults are neutral (0% margin) so output equals list price until you set your real rules.

margin._mode_options: discount = list price is customer reference, subtract discount_pct; markup = list price is cost, add markup_pct
margin._note: Override per customer/volume in customer_tiers below.

customer_tiers._comment: I-MAK list-price discounts by customer type (confirmed 2026-07).

supplier_discounts._comment: What WE pay suppliers = supplier list x (1 - discount). Cost side.

payment_terms._comment: Surcharge % added for deferred payment. From GAMAK bulletin 2026-01; confirm I-MAK's own terms.
